skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts and worldviews of Marxist-Leninist philosophy, including dialectical materialism and historical materialism.
Develop logical and scientific thinking skills, as well as the ability to analyze, compare, synthesize, and systematize scientific issues.
Analyze and interpret economic, political, and social issues using Marxist-Leninist theory.
Work effectively in groups to analyze and discuss philosophical issues.
Act responsibly as a global citizen, applying Marxist-Leninist principles to real-world scenarios.
Conduct independent research and present findings in written form.
Apply theoretical knowledge to practical situations and policy analysis.
